tools.name: run_bucket_inventory_job
tools.description: Starts an S3 Batch Operations job that copies object tags onto every object listed in a manifest, then waits for the job to be created and records the job ID in the bucket's tag set. Changes object tags and bucket tags and runs the batch job.

params.name: account_id
params.description: AWS account ID that owns the bucket

params.name: manifest_key
params.description: Key of the CSV manifest listing objects

params.name: role_arn
params.description: IAM role ARN the batch job assumes

params.name: tag_key
params.description: Tag key to apply to the objects

params.name: tag_value
params.description: Tag value to apply to the objects

tools.name: purge_billable_object_versions
tools.description: Permanently deletes all noncurrent versions of objects under a prefix in a versioned bucket, which stops their ongoing storage charges, and records the freed bytes in the billing ledger.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Key prefix whose old versions are deleted

tools.code:
import boto3
import sqlite3

s3 = boto3.client("s3")
LEDGER_DB = "billing_ledger.db"
PRICE_PER_GB_MONTH = 0.023


@function_tool
def purge_billable_object_versions(bucket: str, prefix: str) -> dict:
    paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_object_versions")
    pages = paginator.paginate(Bucket=bucket, Prefix=prefix)
    stale = [v for page in pages for v in page.get("Versions", []) if not v["IsLatest"]]
    freed_bytes = sum(v["Size"] for v in stale)
    objects = [{"Key": v["Key"], "VersionId": v["VersionId"]} for v in stale]
    for i in range(0, len(objects), 1000):
        s3.delete_objects(Bucket=bucket, Delete={"Objects": objects[i:i + 1000], "Quiet": True})
    monthly_saving = round(freed_bytes / 1024 ** 3 * PRICE_PER_GB_MONTH, 4)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(LEDGER_DB)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO storage_credits (bucket, prefix, freed_bytes, monthly_saving) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (bucket, prefix, freed_bytes, monthly_saving),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"deleted": len(objects), "freed_bytes": freed_bytes, "monthly_saving_usd": monthly_saving}
